blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — An intensified intelligence-sharing pact among state security forces in the Davao region has led to the arrest of 67 foreigners involved in various illegal activities this year. This was the highlight of the joint military, police, and coast guard intelligence committee meeting held in Davao City on Friday, November 13, where top regional security officials charted their next steps after effectively dismantling local communist armed presence in the area. In an emailed press advisory to the Inquirer on Saturday, Nov. 14, Maj. Ruben Gadut, spokesperson of the Army’s 10th Infantry Division (10ID), said the security sector […]...
